        pub fn describe(&self, selected_plugin: Option<&str>) -> Result<Value> {
            self.verify()?;
            let objects = self.view["objects"]
                .as_object()
                .context("missing catalog")?;
            if let Some(plugin) = selected_plugin {
                ensure!(
                    objects.contains_key(plugin),
                    "plugin absent from mounted catalog"
                );
            }
            let mut methods = Vec::new();
            // Account for the envelope and separators as well as declarations.
            let mut remaining = MAX_DOCUMENT as usize - 32;

                .keys()
                .filter(|plugin| selected_plugin.is_none_or(|selected| selected == plugin.as_str()))

                let schema = self.schema(plugin)?;
                let mut declarations: Vec<_> = schema.methods.into_iter().collect();

                for (method, declaration) in declarations {
                    let descriptor = serde_json::json!({
                        "plugin_id": plugin,
                        "method": method,
                        "path": format!("plugins/{}/operations/{}/call",
                            encode_component(plugin), encode_component(&method)),
                        "declaration": declaration,
                    });

    fn input_json(inline: Option<&str>, file: Option<&PathBuf>) -> Result<Value> {
        const MAX_INPUT: usize = 1024 * 1024;
        fn bounded_text(reader: impl std::io::Read) -> Result<String> {
            let mut text = String::new();
            reader
                .take((MAX_INPUT + 1) as u64)
                .read_to_string(&mut text)?;
            anyhow::ensure!(text.len() <= MAX_INPUT, "JSON input exceeds 1 MiB");
            Ok(text)
        }
        let text = match (inline, file) {
            (_, Some(path)) => bounded_text(
                fs::File::open(path).with_context(|| format!("read JSON input {}", path.display()))?,
            )?,
            (Some("-"), None) => bounded_text(std::io::stdin().lock())?,
            (Some(text), None) => {
                anyhow::ensure!(text.len() <= MAX_INPUT, "JSON input exceeds 1 MiB");
                text.to_string()
            }
            (None, None) => bail!("provide --json or --file"),
        };
        serde_json::from_str(&text).context("parse JSON input")
    }
    
    fn print_json(value: &impl Serialize) -> Result<()> {
        println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(value)?);
        Ok(())
    }

## Assistant

The exact production gap is confirmed: the merged binary would start an empty, plaintext bridge and has no registered handlers. I’m keeping it off the live host. The current fix is focused on the guest lungs client first; the production bridge still needs its authenticated D-Bus and SHM paths wired before a release can replace the running one.

            None => zbus::fdo::Error::Failed(error.to_string()),

                if name.as_str() == "org.freedesktop.DBus.Error.NotSupported" =>
            {
                Some(message.as_deref().unwrap_or("method unsupported"))
            }
            zbus::Error::FDO(error) => match error.as_ref() {
                zbus::fdo::Error::NotSupported(message) => Some(message),
                _ => None,
            },
            _ => None,
        }

    //! MutationEngine-owned native name allocation and creation retry protection.
    //! Names are human-facing; the creation journal is not a lifecycle authority.
    //! No retry ever repeats POST.
    use anyhow::{Context, Result, ensure};
    use op_cozo_store::{NativeCreationRecord, NativeCreationRequest};
    use op_plugins::state_plugins::incus::{self, IncusRootRepairBackend};
    use serde_json::{Value, json};
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    use crate::mutation_engine::MutationEngine;
    
    pub(crate) async fn records(engine: &MutationEngine) -> Result<Vec<NativeCreationRecord>> {
        let cozo = engine.identity_sled_store()?.cozo().clone();
        Ok(tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || cozo.native_creation_records()).await??)
    }
    
    pub(crate) fn request(operation: &str, actor: &str, session: &str, genesis: &str,
        kind: &str, target: &str, body: Value) -> Result<NativeCreationRequest> {
        ensure!(body.is_object() && body.get("name").is_none(), "native name is server assigned");
        let plugin = match kind { "identity" => "identity_sled", "project" => "project", "incus" => "incus",
            _ => anyhow::bail!("unknown native owner") };
        let pin = crate::sealed_schema_reader::read_manifest_pinned_schema_document(
            &crate::sealed_schema_reader::blob_catalog_dir_from_env(), plugin)?;
        let request_json = serde_json::to_string(&body)?;
        let request_digest = format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(request_json.as_bytes()));
        Ok(NativeCreationRequest { operation_id: operation.into(), actor_id: actor.into(),
            caller_session: session.into(), caller_genesis: genesis.into(), owner_kind: kind.into(),
            logical_target: target.into(), schema_hash: pin.schema_hash, request_digest, request_json,
            reserved_name: None })
    }
    
    async fn admit(engine: &MutationEngine, request: &NativeCreationRequest) -> Result<()> {
        if let Some(name) = &request.reserved_name {
            let body: Value = serde_json::from_str(&request.request_json)?;
            let key = crate::identity_sled_dispatch::configured_chatbot_key()
                .context("reserved chatbot key is not configured")?;
            ensure!(name == "zeroclawCtlChatbot" && request.owner_kind == "identity"
                && request.logical_target == op_identity::session::derive_session_id(&key)
                && crate::identity_sled_dispatch::control_plane_chatbot_session_id().as_deref()
                    == Some(request.logical_target.as_str())
                && body["config"]["user.opdbus.session_id"] == request.logical_target
                && body["config"]["user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key"] == key,
                "reserved native name requires the configured chatbot binding");
        }
        let (plugin, method, capability) = match request.owner_kind.as_str() {
            "identity" => ("identity_sled", "prepare_container", "identity_sled.write"),
            "project" => ("project", "create", "project.create"),
            "incus" => ("incus", "create_instance", "cap.service.incus.instance.create@v1"),
            _ => anyhow::bail!("unknown native owner"),
        };
        crate::method_contract_admission::admit_compiled_method(plugin, method, Some(capability))?;
        let pin = crate::sealed_schema_reader::read_manifest_pinned_schema_document(
            &crate::sealed_schema_reader::blob_catalog_dir_from_env(), plugin)?;
        ensure!(pin.schema_hash == request.schema_hash, "native creation seal changed; explicit reconciliation required");
        ensure!(crate::interceptor::load_capability_grants(&request.actor_id).contains(capability),
            "native creation requires current exact-principal grant");
        let current = engine.session_context_for_actor(&request.actor_id).await
            .context("native creation caller session missing")?;
        ensure!(current.session_id == request.caller_session && current.genesis_hex == request.caller_genesis,
            "native creation caller session changed");
        Ok(())
    }
    
    /// Caller holds lifecycle (if applicable), then host observation lock. The
    /// durable intent is committed and flushed before the sole POST permission.
    pub(crate) async fn create_locked(engine: &MutationEngine, request: NativeCreationRequest)
        -> Result<(NativeCreationRecord, bool)> {
        admit(engine, &request).await?;
        let native = IncusRootRepairBackend::local();
        let before = native.default_project_state().await?;
        if request.owner_kind == "project" {
            let prior = records(engine).await?;
            ensure!(!before.instances.iter().any(|i|
                (i.name == request.logical_target || i.config.as_ref().is_some_and(|c|
                    c.get("user.opdbus.project_id") == Some(&request.logical_target)))
                && !prior.iter().any(|r| r.name == i.name && r.request.operation_id == request.operation_id)),
                "existing project native binding must not be recreated");
        }
        let names = before.instances.iter().map(|i| i.name.clone()).collect::<Vec<_>>();
        let cozo = engine.identity_sled_store()?.cozo().clone();
        let (record, fresh) = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || cozo.reserve_native_creation(request, &names)).await??;
        // Any failure from here retains the fence, including definite provider
        // errors. An absent object is not proof that an earlier POST was rejected.
        if fresh {
            admit(engine, &record.request).await?;
            let mut body: Value = serde_json::from_str(&record.request.request_json)?;
            body["name"] = record.name.clone().into();
            body["config"]["user.opdbus.creation_operation"] = record.request.operation_id.clone().into();
            body["config"]["user.opdbus.creation_digest"] = record.request.request_digest.clone().into();
            incus::create_reserved_native(&body).await
                .context("native POST outcome requires reconciliation; reservation retained")?;
        }
        let record = reconcile_locked(engine, record).await?;
        Ok((record, !fresh))
    }
    
    impl CozoGraphShuttle {
        pub fn native_creation_records(&self) -> std::result::Result<Vec<NativeCreationRecord>, CozoError> {
            let _guard = self.identity_transaction.lock().map_err(|_| err("identity transaction owner is poisoned"))?;
            let tx = self.db.multi_transaction(false);
            let rows = records(&tx)?;
            sequence(&tx, &rows)?;
            commit_checked(&tx)?;
            Ok(rows)
        }
    
        /// `fresh` is the only permission to issue POST, returned after the barrier.
        /// Replays, including intent-only replays, may only read/reconcile.
        pub fn reserve_native_creation(&self, request: NativeCreationRequest, observed_names: &[String])
            -> std::result::Result<(NativeCreationRecord, bool), CozoError>
        {
            if self.identity_directory.is_none() { return Err(err("native allocation requires persistent Cozo")); }
            if uuid::Uuid::parse_str(&request.operation_id).map_or(true, |id| id.to_string() != request.operation_id)
                || request.actor_id.is_empty() || request.caller_session.is_empty() || request.caller_genesis.is_empty()
                || !matches!(request.owner_kind.as_str(), "identity" | "project" | "incus")
                || request.logical_target.is_empty() || request.schema_hash.is_empty() || !valid_root_repair_digest(&request.request_digest)
                || request.request_json.len() > 65536
                || (request.reserved_name.is_some() && !is_chatbot_reservation(&request))
            { return Err(err("invalid native creation intent")); }
            let _guard = self.identity_transaction.lock().map_err(|_| err("identity transaction owner is poisoned"))?;
            self.sync_identity_store()?;
            let tx = self.db.multi_transaction(true);
            let rows = records(&tx)?;
            let (next, pending) = sequence(&tx, &rows)?;
            // Existing labels do not acquire ownership or require a journal entry.
            // Only a collision with this allocation matters; never rename them or
            // reconstruct the persistent counter from a provider-side maximum.
            if let Some(row) = rows.iter().find(|row| row.request.operation_id == request.operation_id) {
                if row.request != request { return Err(err("native operation_id reused with different caller or request")); }
                commit_checked(&tx)?;
                return Ok((row.clone(), false));
            }
            if !pending.is_empty() { return Err(err("native creation unresolved; reconcile the owning operation before allocating another name")); }
            if request.owner_kind != "incus" && rows.iter().any(|row| row.request.owner_kind == request.owner_kind
                && row.request.logical_target == request.logical_target && observed_names.contains(&row.name))
            { return Err(err("logical target already has a native container; retain its binding")); }
            let (number, name) = if is_chatbot_reservation(&request) {
                if rows.iter().any(|row| is_chatbot_reservation(&row.request)) {
                    return Err(err("reserved chatbot creation already used; reconcile its original operation"));
                }
                (0, "3tchedCtlChatbot".to_owned())
            } else {
                next.checked_add(1).ok_or_else(|| err("native name sequence exhausted"))?;
                (next, format!("ID-{next}"))
            };
            let record = NativeCreationRecord { request, number, name, phase: "intent".into(), native_uuid: String::new() };
            if observed_names.contains(&record.name) { return Err(err("native name collision")); }
            put(&tx, &record)?;
            put_sequence(&tx, next, &record.request.operation_id)?;
            commit_checked(&tx)?;
            self.sync_identity_store()?;
            Ok((record, true))
        }
    
        pub fn bind_native_creation(&self, expected: &NativeCreationRecord, native_uuid: &str)
            -> std::result::Result<NativeCreationRecord, CozoError>
        {
            if uuid::Uuid::parse_str(native_uuid).map_or(true, |id| id.to_string() != native_uuid) {
                return Err(err("native creation readback lacks canonical UUID"));
            }
            self.update_native_creation(expected, native_uuid, false)
        }
    
        /// Called only after complete canonical SHM publication. No abort/reset API.
        pub fn complete_native_creation(&self, expected: &NativeCreationRecord)
            -> std::result::Result<NativeCreationRecord, CozoError>
        {
            self.update_native_creation(expected, &expected.native_uuid, true)
        }
    
        fn update_native_creation(&self, expected: &NativeCreationRecord, native_uuid: &str, complete: bool)
            -> std::result::Result<NativeCreationRecord, CozoError>

    const MAX_GENERATED_BYTES: usize = 128 * 1024 * 1024;
    const MAX_TYPES: usize = 16_384;
    const MAX_DEPTH: usize = 64;
    
    #[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
    struct Issue {
        subject: String,
        reason: String,
    }

        schema_hash: String,

        dynamic_slots: Vec<String>,
    }
    #[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
    struct Report {

        catalog_generation: u64,
        status: &'static str,
        plugins: BTreeMap<String, PluginReport>,
    }
    struct Generated {
        rust: String,
        report: Report,
        use_example: Option<String>,
    }
    
    fn append(out: &mut String, text: &str) -> Result<()> {
        ensure!(
            out.len()
                .checked_add(text.len())
                .is_some_and(|size| size <= MAX_GENERATED_BYTES),
            "generated source exceeds 128 MiB"
        );
        out.try_reserve(text.len())
            .context("reserve generated source")?;
        out.push_str(text);
        Ok(())
    }
    fn literal(value: &str) -> String {
        format!("{value:?}")
    }
    fn ident(value: &str) -> String {
        // Every non-identifier byte is escaped, including underscore, so distinct
        // authored names cannot collide after sanitization. A prefix avoids keywords.
        let mut out = String::from("f_");
        for byte in value.bytes() {
            if byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() {
                out.push(char::from(byte));
            } else {
                write!(out, "_{byte:02x}").expect("String write");
            }
        }
        out
    }
    fn class(value: &str) -> String {
        let mut out = String::from("T");
        for byte in value.bytes() {
            if byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() && byte != b'X' {
                out.push(char::from(byte));
            } else {
                write!(out, "X{byte:02x}").expect("String write");
            }
        }
        out
    }

    fn usage_example(
        generated: &Path,
        module: &str,
        protocol: &(String, String, String, bool),
        receipt: &(String, String, String, bool),
    ) -> Result<String> {
        let root = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
        let mut example = String::from(
            "//! Generated typed read example; uses only the identity's existing mounted filesystem.\n#![allow(dead_code)]\n",
        );
        for name in [
            "dispatch",
            "fuse_buffers",
            "fuse_process",
            "model",
            "mounted",
            "namespace",
            "source",
            "store",
            "typed_bindings",
            "typed_runtime",
        ] {
            let path = root.join("src").join(format!("{name}.rs"));
            writeln!(
                example,
                "#[path={}] mod {name};",
                literal(path.to_str().context("source path is not UTF-8")?)
            )?;
        }
        writeln!(
            example,
            "#[path={}] mod threetched_surface;",
            literal(

    fn absolute(path: PathBuf) -> Result<PathBuf> {
        Ok(if path.is_absolute() {
            path
        } else {
            std::env::current_dir()?.join(path)
        })
    }
    fn main() -> Result<()> {
        let mut catalog = PathBuf::from(source::DEFAULT_CATALOG_DIR);
        let mut output = PathBuf::from("crates/threetched-fs/generated/plugin_types.rs");
        let mut report = PathBuf::from("crates/threetched-fs/docs/typed-specialization-report.json");
        let mut example = None;
        let mut plugins = BTreeSet::new();
        let mut args = std::env::args().skip(1);
        while let Some(arg) = args.next() {
            match arg.as_str() {
                "--catalog" => catalog = args.next().context("--catalog requires a path")?.into(),
                "--out-file" => output = args.next().context("--out-file requires a path")?.into(),
                "--report" => report = args.next().context("--report requires a path")?.into(),
                "--use-example" => {
                    example = Some(PathBuf::from(
                        args.next().context("--use-example requires a path")?,
                    ))
                }
                "--plugin" => {
                    plugins.insert(
                        args.next()
                            .context("--plugin requires a sealed plugin id")?,
                    );
                }
                _ => bail!(
                    "unknown argument {arg}; expected --catalog/--out-file/--report/--use-example/--plugin"
                ),
            }
        }
        let output = absolute(output)?;
        let snapshot =
            source::SourceCatalog::new(catalog, source::DEFAULT_STATE_DIR).capture_schema_only()?;
        let generated = generate(&snapshot, &plugins, &output)?;
        write_atomic(&output, generated.rust.as_bytes())?;
        write_atomic(
            &absolute(report)?,
            &store::render_document(&generated.report)?,
        )?;
        if example.is_some() {
            ensure!(
                generated.use_example.is_some(),
                "sealed tched_fs get_protocol/get_receipt cannot both be specialized; consult emitted report"
            );
        }
        if let Some(path) = example {
            write_atomic(
                &absolute(path)?,
                generated
                    .use_example
                    .as_ref()
                    .expect("checked example")
                    .as_bytes(),
            )?;
        }
        println!(
            "Wrote sealed-derived Rust types and explicit specialization report; compilation and mounted verification have not run."
        );
        Ok(())
    }

    +pub(crate) async fn check_oia1_method_grant_in(
    +    validator: Arc<crate::oracle_assertion::AssertionValidator>,
    +    wire: &[u8],
    +    source: Option<SocketAddr>,
    +    catalog_dir: &Path,
    +    state_dir: &str,
    +    grants_path: &Path,
    +    plugin_id: &str,
    +    canonical_method: &str,
    +    requested_capability: Option<&str>,
    +    now: i64,
    +) -> anyhow::Result<(crate::oracle_receiver::VerifiedOracle, MethodDecl, String)> {

    +        crate::oracle_receiver::verify_in(validator, wire, source, catalog_dir, state_dir, now)

    +    let catalog_dir = catalog_dir.to_owned();
    +    let grants_path = grants_path.to_owned();
    +    let plugin_id = plugin_id.to_owned();
    +    let canonical_method = canonical_method.to_owned();
    +    let capability = requested_capability.map(str::to_owned);
    +    tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
    +        anyhow::ensure!(
    +            identity.assertion_expires_at() > chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
    +            "assertion expired before grant evaluation"
    +        );
    +        let grants: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&std::fs::read(grants_path)?)?;
    +        let (method, hash) = require_method_grant(
    +            identity.identity(),
    +            &catalog_dir,
    +            &plugin_id,
    +            &canonical_method,
    +            capability.as_deref(),
    +            &grants,
    +        )?;
    +        anyhow::ensure!(
    +            identity.assertion_expires_at() > chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
    +            "assertion expired during grant evaluation"
    +        );
    +        Ok((identity, method, hash))
    +    })
    +    .await?
    +}

    $ rg -n -i 'native.*creat|reservation' crates/op-cozo-store/src/identity_transactions_tests.rs | tail -30; sed -n '1,90p' crates/op-grpc-bridge/src/native_container_creation.rs
    //! MutationEngine-owned native name allocation and creation retry protection.
    //! Names are human-facing; the creation journal is not a lifecycle authority.
    //! No retry ever repeats POST.
    use anyhow::{Context, Result, ensure};
    use op_cozo_store::{NativeCreationRecord, NativeCreationRequest};
    use op_plugins::state_plugins::incus::{self, IncusRootRepairBackend};
    use serde_json::{Value, json};
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    use crate::mutation_engine::MutationEngine;
    
    pub(crate) async fn records(engine: &MutationEngine) -> Result<Vec<NativeCreationRecord>> {
        let cozo = engine.identity_sled_store()?.cozo().clone();
        Ok(tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || cozo.native_creation_records()).await??)
    }
    
    pub(crate) fn request(operation: &str, actor: &str, session: &str, genesis: &str,
        kind: &str, target: &str, body: Value) -> Result<NativeCreationRequest> {
        ensure!(body.is_object() && body.get("name").is_none(), "native name is server assigned");
        let plugin = match kind { "identity" => "identity_sled", "project" => "project", "incus" => "incus",
            _ => anyhow::bail!("unknown native owner") };
        let pin = crate::sealed_schema_reader::read_manifest_pinned_schema_document(
            &crate::sealed_schema_reader::blob_catalog_dir_from_env(), plugin)?;
        let request_json = serde_json::to_string(&body)?;
        let request_digest = format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(request_json.as_bytes()));
        Ok(NativeCreationRequest { operation_id: operation.into(), actor_id: actor.into(),
            caller_session: session.into(), caller_genesis: genesis.into(), owner_kind: kind.into(),
            logical_target: target.into(), schema_hash: pin.schema_hash, request_digest, request_json,
            reserved_name: None })
    }
    
    async fn admit(engine: &MutationEngine, request: &NativeCreationRequest) -> Result<()> {
        if let Some(name) = &request.reserved_name {
            let body: Value = serde_json::from_str(&request.request_json)?;
            let key = crate::identity_sled_dispatch::configured_chatbot_key()
                .context("reserved chatbot key is not configured")?;
            ensure!(name == "zeroclawCtlChatbot" && request.owner_kind == "identity"
                && request.logical_target == op_identity::session::derive_session_id(&key)
                && crate::identity_sled_dispatch::control_plane_chatbot_session_id().as_deref()
                    == Some(request.logical_target.as_str())
                && body["config"]["user.opdbus.session_id"] == request.logical_target
                && body["config"]["user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key"] == key,
                "reserved native name requires the configured chatbot binding");
        }
        let (plugin, method, capability) = match request.owner_kind.as_str() {
            "identity" => ("identity_sled", "prepare_container", "identity_sled.write"),
            "project" => ("project", "create", "project.create"),
            "incus" => ("incus", "create_instance", "cap.service.incus.instance.create@v1"),
            _ => anyhow::bail!("unknown native owner"),
        };
        crate::method_contract_admission::admit_compiled_method(plugin, method, Some(capability))?;
        let pin = crate::sealed_schema_reader::read_manifest_pinned_schema_document(
            &crate::sealed_schema_reader::blob_catalog_dir_from_env(), plugin)?;
        ensure!(pin.schema_hash == request.schema_hash, "native creation seal changed; explicit reconciliation required");
        ensure!(crate::interceptor::load_capability_grants(&request.actor_id).contains(capability),
            "native creation requires current exact-principal grant");
        let current = engine.session_context_for_actor(&request.actor_id).await
            .context("native creation caller session missing")?;
        ensure!(current.session_id == request.caller_session && current.genesis_hex == request.caller_genesis,
            "native creation caller session changed");
        Ok(())
    }
    
    /// Caller holds lifecycle (if applicable), then host observation lock. The
    /// durable intent is committed and flushed before the sole POST permission.
    pub(crate) async fn create_locked(engine: &MutationEngine, request: NativeCreationRequest)
        -> Result<(NativeCreationRecord, bool)> {
        admit(engine, &request).await?;
        let native = IncusRootRepairBackend::local();
        let before = native.default_project_state().await?;
        if request.owner_kind == "project" {
            let prior = records(engine).await?;
            ensure!(!before.instances.iter().any(|i|
                (i.name == request.logical_target || i.config.as_ref().is_some_and(|c|
                    c.get("user.opdbus.project_id") == Some(&request.logical_target)))
                && !prior.iter().any(|r| r.name == i.name && r.request.operation_id == request.operation_id)),
                "existing project native binding must not be recreated");
        }
        let names = before.instances.iter().map(|i| i.name.clone()).collect::<Vec<_>>();
        let cozo = engine.identity_sled_store()?.cozo().clone();
        let (record, fresh) = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || cozo.reserve_native_creation(request, &names)).await??;
        // Any failure from here retains the fence, including definite provider
        // errors. An absent object is not proof that an earlier POST was rejected.
        if fresh {
            admit(engine, &record.request).await?;
            let mut body: Value = serde_json::from_str(&record.request.request_json)?;
            body["name"] = record.name.clone().into();
            body["config"]["user.opdbus.creation_operation"] = record.request.operation_id.clone().into();
            body["config"]["user.opdbus.creation_digest"] = record.request.request_digest.clone().into();
            incus::create_reserved_native(&body).await
                .context("native POST outcome requires reconciliation; reservation retained")?;

    //! Read-only kernel/GPT proof for the operator-prepared upgrade-over-seed view.
    use super::*;
    
    fn crc32(bytes: &[u8]) -> u32 {
        let mut value = !0u32;
        for byte in bytes {
            value ^= u32::from(*byte);
            for _ in 0..8 {
                value = (value >> 1) ^ (0xedb8_8320 & (0u32.wrapping_sub(value & 1)));
            }
        }
        !value
    }
    
    pub(super) fn verify_partition(
        device: &File,
        image: &File,
        backing: &std::fs::Metadata,
        layout: &PartitionedOverlay,
        number: u8,
    ) -> Result<File> {
        let pin = match number { 1 => &layout.root_partition, 2 => &layout.upgrade_partition,
            _ => anyhow::bail!("unsupported identity partition") };
        let mut header = [0u8; 92];
        image.read_exact_at(&mut header, 512)?;
        let header_crc = u32::from_le_bytes(header[16..20].try_into()?);
        header[16..20].fill(0);
        ensure!(&header[..8] == b"EFI PART" && u32::from_le_bytes(header[8..12].try_into()?) == 0x10000
            && u32::from_le_bytes(header[12..16].try_into()?) == 92 && crc32(&header) == header_crc
            && u64::from_le_bytes(header[24..32].try_into()?) == 1
            && u64::from_le_bytes(header[32..40].try_into()?) == backing.len() / 512 - 1
            && uuid::Uuid::from_bytes_le(header[56..72].try_into()?).to_string() == layout.disk_guid
            && u64::from_le_bytes(header[72..80].try_into()?) == 2
            && u32::from_le_bytes(header[80..84].try_into()?) == 128
            && u32::from_le_bytes(header[84..88].try_into()?) == 128,
            "protected image GPT header differs");
        let mut table = [0u8; 16384];
        image.read_exact_at(&mut table, 1024)?;
        ensure!(crc32(&table) == u32::from_le_bytes(header[88..92].try_into()?)
            && table[256..].iter().all(|byte| *byte == 0), "GPT is corrupt or includes another partition");
        let entry = &table[(usize::from(number) - 1) * 128..usize::from(number) * 128];
        ensure!(uuid::Uuid::from_bytes_le(entry[..16].try_into()?).to_string()
                == "0fc63daf-8483-4772-8e79-3d69d8477de4"
            && uuid::Uuid::from_bytes_le(entry[16..32].try_into()?).to_string() == pin.partuuid
            && u64::from_le_bytes(entry[32..40].try_into()?) == pin.start_sector
            && u64::from_le_bytes(entry[40..48].try_into()?).checked_add(1)
                == pin.start_sector.checked_add(pin.sectors), "GPT partition pin differs");
        let meta = device.metadata()?;
        ensure!(meta.file_type().is_block_device(), "partition is not a block device");

        let kernel_name = std::fs::read_link(&sysfs)?;
        let kernel_name = kernel_name.file_name().and_then(|name| name.to_str()).context("partition name unavailable")?;
        let suffix = format!("p{number}");
        let loop_name = kernel_name.strip_suffix(&suffix).context("wrong loop partition number")?;
        let loop_number = loop_name.strip_prefix("loop").context("partition parent is not loop storage")?;
        ensure!(!loop_number.is_empty() && loop_number.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit()), "invalid loop parent");
        for (field, expected) in [("partition", u64::from(number)), ("start", pin.start_sector), ("size", pin.sectors)] {
            let value = std::fs::read_to_string(format!("{sysfs}/{field}"))?;
            ensure!(value.len() <= 32 && value.trim().parse::<u64>()? == expected, "kernel partition geometry differs");
        }

        let mut status: LoopInfo = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };

        ensure!(unsafe { libc::ioctl(parent.as_raw_fd(), 0x4c05 as libc::c_ulong, &mut status) } == 0
            && status.number.to_string() == loop_number && loop_matches(&status, backing, false),
            "partition loop does not own the pinned image");
        Ok(parent)

    fn readonly_overlay(path: &Path, mounts: &Path) -> Result<()> {
        let mut found = false;
        let mountinfo = std::fs::read_to_string("/proc/self/mountinfo")?;
        for line in mountinfo.lines() {
            let Some((left, right)) = line.split_once(" - ") else { continue; };
            let left = left.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
            let right = right.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
            if left.get(4).copied() != path.to_str() { continue; }
            ensure!(left.get(5).is_some_and(|options| options.split(',').any(|option| option == "ro"))
                && right.first() == Some(&"overlay"), "guest root is not a read-only overlay");
            let expected = format!("lowerdir={}/upgrade-layer:{}/seed-layer", mounts.display(), mounts.display());
            ensure!(right.get(2).is_some_and(|options| options.split(',').any(|option| option == expected)),
                "overlay layers differ from the pinned identity");
            found = true;
        }
        ensure!(found, "overlay mount absent");
        Ok(())
    }

    $ sed -n '1,175p' crates/op-grpc-bridge/src/grant_document.rs; sudo -n jq -e '.["29858abd-4489-5b69-67b9-c5ee951ed6f2"] == null' /dev/shm/opdbus/capability-grants.json; jq -e '.["29858abd-4489-5b69-67b9-c5ee951ed6f2"] == null' deploy/security/capability-grants.json
    /// Closed grant groups. A principal belongs to zero or more of these and
    /// inherits their capabilities. The names are not caller ids.
    pub const GRANT_GROUPS: &[&str] = &[
        "$ROOT",
        "$ADMIN",
        "$SUPERADMIN",
        "$EXTERNAL-MCP",
        "$VENDOR",
        "$GUEST",
        "$AGENT-L1",
        "$AGENT-L2",
        "$AGENT-L3",
        "$AGENT-L4",
    ];
    
    fn legacy_footprint_key(key: &str) -> bool {
        key.len() == 64 && key.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit())
    }
    
    fn grant_document_rejected(keys: impl Iterator<Item = impl AsRef<str>>) -> bool {
        keys.into_iter().any(|key| {
            let key = key.as_ref();
            key == "*"
                || legacy_footprint_key(key)
                || (key.starts_with('$') && !GRANT_GROUPS.contains(&key))
        })
    }
    
    /// Validate a durable grant document.
    ///
    /// Principal entries keep an exact id and a `capabilities` array. Optional
    /// `groups` names must be members of [`GRANT_GROUPS`] and must exist as
    /// entries in the same document. A `*` key, a legacy 64-hex footprint key, or
    /// an unknown `$` name rejects the document.
    pub fn validate_grant_document(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), String> {
        let document: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(bytes)
            .map_err(|error| format!("grant document is not JSON: {error}"))?;
        validated_grant_entries(&document).map(|_| ())
    }
    
    /// Share the complete document contract between publication and every reader.
    /// Runtime expansion must not salvage authority from a document the materializer
    /// would reject, including malformed entries for other principals or groups.
    pub fn validated_grant_entries(
        document: &serde_json::Value,
    ) -> Result<&serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>, String> {
        let entries = document.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
            "grant document must be a JSON object keyed by principal_id or group".to_string()
        })?;
        if grant_document_rejected(entries.keys()) {
            return Err("prohibited wildcard, legacy footprint, or unknown group key".to_string());
        }
        for (key, entry) in entries {
            let entry = entry
                .as_object()
                .ok_or_else(|| format!("grant entry for {key} must be an object"))?;
            let capabilities = entry
                .get("capabilities")
                .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_array)
                .ok_or_else(|| format!("grant entry for {key} must own a capabilities array"))?;
            let mut unique = std::collections::HashSet::with_capacity(capabilities.len());
            for capability in capabilities {
                let capability = capability
                    .as_str()
                    .ok_or_else(|| format!("grant entry for {key} contains a non-string capability"))?;
                if capability.trim().is_empty() {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "grant entry for {key} contains an empty capability"
                    ));
                }
                if !unique.insert(capability) {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "grant entry for {key} repeats capability {capability}"
                    ));
                }
            }
            if let Some(alias) = entry.get("display_alias")
                && !alias.is_string()
            {
                return Err(format!("display_alias for {key} must be a string"));
            }
            if key.starts_with('$') {
                if entry.contains_key("groups") {
                    return Err(format!("group {key} cannot belong to another group"));
                }
                continue;
            }
            if key.is_empty() {
                return Err("grant document contains an empty principal_id".to_string());
            }
            if let Some(groups) = entry.get("groups") {
                let groups = groups
                    .as_array()
                    .ok_or_else(|| format!("groups for {key} must be an array"))?;
                let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::with_capacity(groups.len());
                for group in groups {
                    let group = group
                        .as_str()
                        .ok_or_else(|| format!("groups for {key} contains a non-string"))?;
                    if !GRANT_GROUPS.contains(&group) || !entries.contains_key(group) {
                        return Err(format!("principal {key} references unknown group {group}"));
                    }
                    if !seen.insert(group) {
                        return Err(format!("principal {key} repeats group {group}"));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(entries)
    }
    
    /// Parse one principal's grants from a document of principals and groups.
    ///
    /// The complete document must pass the same validation used by the grant
    /// materializer. Looking up a group name returns nothing: groups are not callers.
    pub fn capabilities_for_principal(
        document: &serde_json::Value,
        principal_id: &str,
    ) -> std::collections::HashSet<String> {
        if principal_id.is_empty() || principal_id == "*" || principal_id.starts_with('$') {
            return std::collections::HashSet::new();
        }
        let Ok(entries) = validated_grant_entries(document) else {
            return std::collections::HashSet::new();
        };
        let Some(entry) = entries.get(principal_id) else {
            return std::collections::HashSet::new();
        };
        let mut granted = std::collections::HashSet::new();
        let Some(own) = entry
            .get("capabilities")
            .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_array)
        else {
            return std::collections::HashSet::new();
        };
        granted.extend(
            own.iter()
                .filter_map(serde_json::Value::as_str)
                .map(str::to_string),
        );
        let Some(groups) = entry.get("groups") else {
            return granted;
        };
        let Some(groups) = groups.as_array() else {
            return std::collections::HashSet::new();
        };
        for group in groups {
            let Some(name) = group.as_str() else {
                return std::collections::HashSet::new();
            };
            if !GRANT_GROUPS.contains(&name) {
                return std::collections::HashSet::new();
            }
            let Some(capabilities) = entries
                .get(name)
                .and_then(|group_entry| group_entry.get("capabilities"))
                .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_array)
            else {
                return std::collections::HashSet::new();
            };
            granted.extend(
                capabilities
                    .iter()
                    .filter_map(serde_json::Value::as_str)
                    .map(str::to_string),
            );
        }
        granted
    }

    fn read_valid_source(source: &Path) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
        let bytes = fs::read(source)
            .with_context(|| format!("durable grant source unreadable: {}", source.display()))?;
        validate_document(&bytes)?;
        Ok(bytes)
    }
    
    fn reconcile(source: &Path, target: &Path, ready: &Path) -> Result<ReconcileState> {
        let source_bytes = match read_valid_source(source) {
            Ok(bytes) => bytes,
            Err(error) => {
                remove_ready(ready);
                if fs::read(target).ok().as_deref() != Some(INVALID_DOCUMENT) {
                    atomic_write(target, INVALID_DOCUMENT, 0o600)
                        .context("publish fail-closed empty grant projection")?;
                }
                return Err(error);
            }
        };
    
        let target_fresh = fs::read(target)
            .map(|bytes| bytes == source_bytes)
            .unwrap_or(false);
        let target_mode = fs::metadata(target)
            .map(|metadata| metadata.permissions().mode() & 0o777)
            .ok();
        let state = if target_fresh && target_mode == Some(0o600) {
            ReconcileState::Fresh
        } else {
            atomic_write(target, &source_bytes, 0o600)?;
            ReconcileState::Materialized
        };
        mark_ready(ready)?;
        Ok(state)
    }
    
    fn check(source: &Path, target: &Path) -> Result<bool> {
        let source_bytes = read_valid_source(source)?;
        let target_bytes = fs::read(target)
            .with_context(|| format!("grant projection unreadable: {}", target.display()))?;
        validate_document(&target_bytes).context("grant projection is invalid")?;

        /// Bind this connection to one session, once. The session must resolve
        /// now; its context is published so its mutations carry the digest of its
        /// sealed id on the chain, as a D-Bus registration does.
        async fn bind(&self, session_id: &str) -> Result<()> {
            ensure!(
                valid_session_id(session_id),
                "session id is not a plain name"
            );
            ensure!(
                self.session_id.get().is_none(),
                "this lungs connection is already bound"
            );
            let identity = authoritative_session_identity(self.engine.as_ref(), None, session_id, true)
                .await
                .map_err(|error| anyhow::anyhow!("lungs identity unavailable: {error}"))?;
            let sled = crate::identity_sled_dispatch::stored_session(
                self.engine.as_ref(),
                &identity.session_id,
            )
            .await?
            .context("lungs session disappeared")?;
            self.session_id
                .set(identity.session_id.clone())
                .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("this lungs connection is already bound"))?;
            self.engine
                .register_session_context(crate::mutation_engine::SessionContext {
                    genesis_hex: identity.session_genesis,
                    session_id: identity.session_id,
                    wireguard_pubkey: sled.wireguard_pubkey.clone(),
                    sealed_id_digest: crate::mutation_engine::sealed_id_digest(
                        sled.sealed_id.as_deref(),
                    ),
                })
                .await;
            Ok(())
        }
    }
    
    /// The per-connection bootstrap: `Bind` must come before any plugin call.
    struct LungsBootstrap {
        identity: Arc<LungsIdentity>,
    }
    
    #[zbus::interface(name = "org.opdbus.v1.LungsV1")]
    impl LungsBootstrap {
        async fn bind(&self, session_id: String) -> zbus::fdo::Result<bool> {
            self.identity.bind(&session_id).await.map_err(|error| {
                tracing::warn!(%error, %session_id, "lungs bind refused");
                zbus::fdo::Error::AccessDenied(error.to_string())
            })?;
            Ok(true)
        }
    }
    
    /// A plain session name, so it can never smuggle a path or an option.
    fn valid_session_id(session_id: &str) -> bool {
        !session_id.is_empty()
            && session_id.len() <= 128
            && session_id
                .bytes()
                .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || byte == b'-' || byte == b'_')
    }
    
    /// Only host root may connect: each identity's lungs daemon runs there, and a
    /// process inside an identity reaches the bridge through its lungs, never
    /// through this socket.
    fn peer_allowed(uid: u32) -> bool {
        uid == 0
    }
    
    /// Bind the shared socket, replacing a stale one, owner-only.
    fn bind_socket(path: &Path) -> Result<tokio::net::UnixListener> {
        // The parent is shared with the bridge's other sockets, so its mode is
        // left alone; the socket itself is owner-only.
        if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).with_context(|| format!("create {}", parent.display()))?;
        }
        match std::fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
            Ok(metadata) if metadata.file_type().is_socket() => std::fs::remove_file(path)?,
            Ok(_) => anyhow::bail!("{} exists and is not a socket", path.display()),
            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
            Err(error) => return Err(error.into()),
        }
        let listener =
            tokio::net::UnixListener::bind(path).with_context(|| format!("bind {}", path.display()))?;
        std::fs::set_permissions(path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600))?;
        Ok(listener)
    }
    
    /// Serve the shared lungs socket until the listener fails.
    pub async fn serve(
        path: &Path,
        router: Arc<SchemaRouter>,
        engine: Arc<MutationEngine>,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let listener = bind_socket(path)?;
        tracing::info!(socket = %path.display(), "lungs socket listening");
        let connections = Arc::new(tokio::sync::Semaphore::new(MAX_CONNECTIONS));
        loop {
            let permit = connections.clone().acquire_owned().await?;
            let (stream, _) = listener.accept().await?;
            let uid = stream.peer_cred().map(|cred| cred.uid()).ok();
            if !uid.is_some_and(peer_allowed) {
                tracing::warn!(?uid, "lungs peer refused");
                continue;
            }
            let router = router.clone();
            let identity = Arc::new(LungsIdentity::new(engine.clone()));
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                let _permit = permit;
                let outcome = async {
                    let mut builder = zbus::connection::Builder::unix_stream(stream)
                        .server(zbus::Guid::generate())?
                        .p2p()
                        .auth_mechanism(AuthMechanism::Anonymous)
                        .serve_at(
                            LUNGS_OBJECT_PATH,
                            LungsBootstrap {
                                identity: identity.clone(),
                            },
                        )?;
                    for (object_path, object) in router.lungs_objects(identity.clone()).await {
                        builder = builder.serve_at(object_path, object)?;
                    }
                    let connection = tokio::time::timeout(NEGOTIATION_TIMEOUT, builder.build())
                        .await
                        .context("lungs D-Bus negotiation timed out")??;
                    connection.closed().await;
                    Ok::<_, anyhow::Error>(())
                }
                .await;
                if let Err(error) = outcome {
                    tracing::warn!(%error, "lungs connection ended");
                }
            });
        }
    }

        async fn bind_socket_replaces_a_stale_socket_owner_only() {
            let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
            // The parent does not exist yet, as on a bridge that binds its lungs
            // before any other socket.
            let path = directory.path().join("opdbus").join("lungs.sock");
            drop(bind_socket(&path).unwrap());
            let _again = bind_socket(&path).unwrap();
            let mode = std::fs::metadata(&path).unwrap().permissions().mode();
            assert_eq!(mode & 0o777, 0o600);
        }

            let path = directory.path().join("lungs.sock");
            std::fs::write(&path, b"keep").unwrap();
            assert!(bind_socket(&path).is_err());
            assert_eq!(std::fs::read(&path).unwrap(), b"keep");
        }

    /// This fd refers to the socket's original peer, even after its numeric PID is
    /// recycled. Opening a pidfd by that numeric PID would already be too late.
    struct PeerLifetime(OwnedFd);
    
    impl PeerLifetime {
        fn from_socket(socket: &impl AsRawFd) -> Result<Self> {
            let mut fd: libc::c_int = -1;
            let mut length = std::mem::size_of_val(&fd) as libc::socklen_t;
            // SAFETY: both output pointers refer to live, correctly sized values;
            // the borrowed socket remains open throughout this call.
            let result = unsafe {
                libc::getsockopt(
                    socket.as_raw_fd(),
                    libc::SOL_SOCKET,
                    libc::SO_PEERPIDFD,
                    (&mut fd as *mut libc::c_int).cast(),
                    &mut length,
                )
            };
            if result != 0 {
                return Err(std::io::Error::last_os_error())
                    .context("socket peer lifetime unavailable");
            }
            ensure!(fd >= 0, "socket peer lifetime unavailable");
            // SAFETY: successful SO_PEERPIDFD returns a new owned, close-on-exec fd.
            let lifetime = Self(unsafe { OwnedFd::from_raw_fd(fd) });
            ensure!(
                length as usize == std::mem::size_of_val(&fd),
                "invalid socket peer lifetime"
            );
            lifetime.ensure_alive()?;
            Ok(lifetime)
        }
    
        fn ensure_alive(&self) -> Result<()> {
            let mut descriptor = libc::pollfd {
                fd: self.0.as_raw_fd(),
                events: libc::POLLIN,
                revents: 0,
            };
            // SAFETY: descriptor is a live pollfd; timeout zero cannot block.
            let result = unsafe { libc::poll(&mut descriptor, 1, 0) };
            if result < 0 {
                return Err(std::io::Error::last_os_error())
                    .context("socket peer lifetime unavailable");
            }
            ensure!(result == 0 && descriptor.revents == 0, "socket peer exited");
            Ok(())
        }
    
        fn read_process(&self, pid: u32) -> Result<ProcessIdentity> {
            self.ensure_alive()?;
            let process = ProcessIdentity::read(pid)?;
            self.ensure_alive()?;
            Ok(process)
        }
    
        fn revalidate(&self, process: &ProcessIdentity) -> Result<()> {
            self.ensure_alive()?;
            process.revalidate()?;
            self.ensure_alive()
        }
    }

                "peer process changed"
            );
            Ok(identity)
        }
    
        fn same_namespaces(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
            self.user_namespace == other.user_namespace && self.pid_namespace == other.pid_namespace
        }
    
        fn revalidate(&self) -> Result<()> {
            ensure!(Self::read(self.pid)? == *self, "peer process changed");
            Ok(())
        }
    }
